blocks.text: Max Mackinnon poured in 30 points as Australia officially punched its ticket to next year’s Fiba Basketball World Cup in Qatar with an 84-67 win over a gritty Iran. Mackinnon, the Brisbane Bullets sharpshooter, buried 8-of-10 three-pointers at Karisma Arena in Seremban, Malaysia on Friday night. READ: Gilas gains opening as Jordan, Iran lose big in Fiba qualifiers Mackinnon scored 21 points after halftime and was the clear difference between the teams in their World Cup Asian Qualifier.
